title: 第十五章 你碗里是什么第十六章 我也没想到啊
slug: 老太太不服老修仙界里做烧烤
content_zh:
“真的？婆婆就知道你能行！”
叶晚秋拉住游星的手，眼里是止不住地心疼，“两三天不见，你看看这又瘦了……”
游星摸摸自己的脸，“有吗？”
“有！”夏景景在一旁点头。
下一秒，她搂住叶晚秋的另一条胳膊，撒娇道：“那婆婆我们今天吃什么啊？不对不对，是游星师姐出关，做点什么好吃的给她补补呢？”
叶晚秋笑着回答：“早就准备好了！我擀了面条，炖了鱼汤，一会儿煮个鱼汤面，煎了几个馅饼，炖了红烧肉，还有泡的笋丝小凉菜！”
“太好了！”夏景景开心了片刻，故作吃味道：“游星师姐回来就是不一样，菜都比之前更丰盛了。”
游星笑着摇头，“那一会儿多让你吃两块肉。”
叶晚秋不喜欢让别人插手和自己一起做饭，最多也就是帮忙收拾收拾食材。
所以在夏景景和游星两人提出要帮忙时，她将两人推到院子里，让她们坐下喝杯茶歇会儿。
“婆婆，这个小垫子是你缝的吗？好可爱啊。”夏景景拿起放在篮子里的一个小棉垫。
手摸上去软乎乎的，已经缝了大半，还有最后一点点没有收尾。
叶晚秋嗯了声，“有只小猫这两天一直过来，我喂它吃了点东西后，还挺听话的，就打算给它缝个垫子。”
“小猫？”夏景景疑惑，“后山上还有小猫吗？”
游星说：“应当是野猫或者哪位弟子带上山的，婆婆你小心些，别被它抓伤了。”
“放心，我这么大年纪，要是连只猫都收拾不了那不白活了吗？”
叶晚秋想到刚见面时那猫呲牙咧嘴冲自己哈气的样子，再想想这两天一进院子就蹭自己的脚。
小猫而已，能有什么坏心思呢。
面团是刚才就已经和好的，做面条的面要和的硬一些，醒发一会儿，吃起来才够劲道。
之前叶晚秋也是去菜市场买人已经做好的面条，许久没有自己做，和的面有点太硬了。

不想浪费，叶晚秋寻思着自己再揉揉，实在揉不动再说。
没想到揉起来还行，将整块面擀成大饼，她也只是额头上出了点汗。
将面饼叠起来，用刀切成细面条。
锅里煮好的鱼汤将鱼肉捞出来，等小猫来了给小猫吃，鱼汤则用来下面条。
面条切得比较细，水开后煮上一会儿就熟了。
盛进碗里，撒上几颗翠绿的葱花。
馅饼是一开始就做好的，用干净的棉布盖着，此刻还是热乎乎的。
小锅里的红烧肉再收个汁……
“小师妹！”
听到院子外的声音，夏景景抬头看过去，“唐凌师兄，你怎么来了？”
“我问了其他师弟，得知你来了这里。”
唐凌的视线落在她身上，“游星师姐，你也在啊。”
游星微微点头。
唐凌将手里的书递给夏景景，说道：“景景，这是我之前在藏书阁找到的一本心法，你可以看看，多稳固灵力，筑基时也能容易些。”
“多谢师兄！”夏景景将书妥善收起来。
唐凌的视线在小院里打量一圈，不解道：“景景，游星师姐，你们来这里是……”
“景景，是向阳他们来了吗？”
叶晚秋端着饺子从屋里走出来，与唐凌打了个照面。
content_en:
"Really? My mother-in-law knew you could do it!"
Ye Wanqiu held You Xing's hand, his eyes couldn't help but feel distressed, "We haven't seen each other for two or three days. Look, I've lost weight again..."
Yusei touched his face, "Is there any?"
"Yes!" Xia Jingjing nodded aside.
The next second, she hugged Ye Wanqiu's other arm and said coquettishly: "What shall we eat today, mother-in-law? No, no, it's Senior Sister You Xing who is out of seclusion. Why don't you make something delicious to feed her?"
Ye Wanqiu replied with a smile: "It has been prepared for a long time! I rolled out the noodles, stewed the fish soup, cooked a fish soup noodle in a while, fried a few pies, stewed the braised pork, and soaked the shredded bamboo shoots as a cold dish!"
"That's great!" Xia Jingjing was happy for a moment and pretended to eat: "Senior Sister You Xing is different when she comes back. The dishes are more abundant than before."
Yusei smiled and shook his head, "I'll let you eat two more pieces of meat later."
Ye Wanqiu doesn't like to let others interfere with cooking with him. At most, he can only help clean up the ingredients.
So when Xia Jingjing and You Xing asked for help, she pushed them into the yard and asked them to sit down and have a cup of tea to rest.
"Mother-in-law, did you sew this little cushion? It's so cute." Xia Jingjing picked up a small cotton cushion placed in the basket.
It felt soft to the touch, and most of it had been sewn, and the last bit was still unfinished.
Ye Wanqiu hummed, "There is a kitten that has been coming here for the past two days. After I fed it some food, it became quite obedient, so I planned to sew a mat for it."
"Kitten?" Xia Jingjing wondered, "Are there any kittens on the back mountain?"
You Xing said: "It must have been a wild cat or one of the disciples who brought it up the mountain. Mother-in-law, be careful, don't get scratched by it."
"Don't worry, at my age, if I can't even take care of a cat, wouldn't my life be in vain?"
Ye Wanqiu thought about the way the cat grinned and huffed at him when they first met, and then thought about how the cat rubbed his feet whenever he entered the yard in the past two days.
It's just a kitten, what bad intentions can it have?
The dough has been kneaded just now. The noodles used for making noodles need to be kneaded a little harder and they need to rest for a while before they taste chewy enough.
Before, Ye Wanqiu also went to the vegetable market to buy pre-made noodles. It had been a long time since she made her own noodles, and the noodles she made were a bit too hard.
Not wanting to waste it, Ye Wanqiu thought about rubbing it again, but he couldn't do it anymore.
Unexpectedly, it was okay to knead it, and when she rolled the whole piece of dough into a flatbread, she only had a little sweat on her forehead.
Stack the dough and cut into thin noodles with a knife.
Remove the fish meat from the cooked fish soup in the pot and feed it to the kitten when it comes. The fish soup is used to make noodles.
The noodles are cut relatively thin and cooked after boiling for a while.
Pour into a bowl and sprinkle with a few green onions.
The pie was made right from the beginning, covered with a clean cotton cloth, and was still warm at the moment.
Let the braised pork in the small pot collect the juice...
"Little junior sister!"
Hearing the sound outside the courtyard, Xia Jingjing looked up and asked, "Senior Brother Tang Ling, why are you here?"
"I asked other junior brothers and learned that you are here."
Tang Ling's eyes fell on her, "Sister You Xing, you are here too."
Yusei nodded slightly.
Tang Ling handed the book in his hand to Xia Jingjing and said, "Jingjing, this is a mental method I found in the library. You can take a look. The more you stabilize your spiritual power, the easier it will be to build the foundation."
"Thank you, senior brother!" Xia Jingjing put the book away properly.
Tang Ling looked around the small courtyard and said in confusion: "Jingjing, Senior Sister You Xing, why are you here..."
"Jingjing, are Xiangyang and the others here?"
Ye Wanqiu walked out of the house holding dumplings and met Tang Ling face to face.
